description:
Reported 2026-10-28 by a Claude Code worker (carrot) driving its Codex reviewer's pane after Codex exited to the shell: muster pane send --pane

"" --enter left the command typed at the zsh prompt, and a second muster pane send --pane

--key enter was needed. The parallel-work skill says text and its Return in one call are taken by a harness; at a plain shell prompt they were not. Impact: an agent restarting a harness in a pane believes it ran when it did not.
title: pane send '<command>' --enter at a zsh prompt typed the command without submitting it
